contexts.text: There then arises serenity, or silence.
With a silent, or a counterfeiting, face.
Still one can be silent (there), and thus not divulge the thoughts.
Silence in Heaven () = amazement there at those who say they are in faith... AE 487.
Then the whole city is silent.
I spoke with them in the silence...
The interior World was closed, as I could perceive by the sudden silence. SE 2856, Explained.
Next morning... I perceived nothing but a tranquil silence around me.
In silence (the Dutch who have not received faith) resist...
The evil keep speaking... but I have as it were a silence.
There was a visitation, and then a silence.
It is said twice, Be not silent from me (); for one relates to Divine good, and the other to Divine truth.
Sit in silence and within darkness () = in falsities and thence in damnation.
